svg.title: Score Distribution Archetype Gallery
svg.desc: Six small-multiple panels showing archetypal score distributions for a 5-person team on a 1-5 scale. Each panel shows a dot-plot with composite mean line, standard deviation annotation, diagnostic interpretation, and facilitation response. Archetypes: Uniform High, Uniform Low, High Average High Variance, Bimodal Split, Single Outlier, and Gradually Decreasing.
svg.text: Six archetypal patterns in team diagnostic scores (5 members, 1-5 scale). Identical axes for comparison.

g.text: Likely near Consistent. Verify with probing.
Caution: uniform 5s may signal social desirability.
Probe: "Describe a time you didn't do this."
Emerging stage. Honest assessment is valuable.
Team is consistent but early. Investment needed.
Praise honesty. Plan targeted zone investment.
Some members/areas lag. Investigate the spread.
Average is misleading. Team is split.
Check: role-based, tenure-based, or adoption split?
Do NOT declare competency. Address the split.
High-performing team + one gap. Targeted fix.
Likely onboarding or access barrier, not resistance.
Protect the outlier. Pair with high performers.

svg.text: All panels: 1-5 frequency scale. Dashed line = composite mean. Dot color encodes score range.
A composite average of 3.5 that is actually 5+5+5+2+1 tells a different story from 4+4+3+3+4.
Always examine the distribution shape before interpreting the stage.
See Scoring Thresholds and Interpreting Results for full guidance on each pattern.
